Alex — thanks, looping in answers below and attaching the QA matrix with our initial responses for the IAM section (tab: IAM). We kept items short to help your review.

Highlights / direct answers:
- SOC 2: Redwood completed SOC 2 Type II (security & availability) for the period ending 2025-11-30. Full report available once an NDA is in place; summary attached.
- SSO/SAML: We support SAML 2.0 (IdP-initiated and SP-initiated). We require standard metadata: entityID, ACS URL, x.509 certificate (PEM) for verification. Optional: NameID format and attribute map (email, givenName, familyName).
- SCIM: SCIM 2.0 with bearer-token seeding for provisioning. Supported mappings: userName, externalId, active, emails[type=work], name.givenName, name.familyName, groups (for RBAC). Bulk provisioning supported via PATCH.
- RBAC & admin controls: RBAC model with pre-defined roles (admin, manager, reader) plus ability to add custom roles via API. Admin actions are auditable; we retain admin/audit logs for 365 days by default (longer retention options available in Dedicated/Private).

Attachments: helix_qa_matrix.xlsx (filled IAM tab).

Next asks from Redwood to Helix (short):
1) If you can share your IdP metadata file or IdP admin contact, we’ll prepare an SP metadata bundle and test account.
2) For SCIM onboarding, provide a test user and an agreed attribute mapping — we can do an isolated sandbox.

If helpful, I suggest a 30-min technical handoff with your IdP admin + our infra engineer (Karthik). Proposed times: Tue 2/17 10:00-10:30 or Wed 2/18 14:00-14:30 ET. Which works?

—Monica
Monica Patel

Alex / team — quick technical note before the handoff call: 

- For SAML certificate rollover we support SHA-256 thumbprints. If your IdP rotates certs frequently, please share the metadata endpoint (URL) so we can poll during the test window.
- For SCIM provisioning tokens: we create a scoped service account token that can be rotated; recommend creating a test service account with limited privileges (provision/unprovision only).
- Audit/event stream: do you want admin events pushed to your SIEM (syslog/HTTP forwarder) or do you prefer periodic exports? We can support either for Dedicated/Private; hosted API has webhook-forwarding for critical admin alerts.

I’ll hold the proposed slots for Tue/Wed next week — reply with preferred time and IdP contact. We’ll also attach a short runbook during the call (SAML metadata checklist + SCIM mapping examples).

Karthik Iyer
Infra Engineer — Identity & Security Integrations | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
